facts.text: Snow left Buckskin Lower (6,920 ft) 25 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Buckskin Lower
evidence.detail: left April 3; earlier seasons: May 12 (2023), April 27 (2024), April 28 (2025)

facts.text: At Buckskin Lower (6,920 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 0.5 in, the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026).

evidence.name: Buckskin Lower
evidence.detail: 0.5 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 21.8 in (2023), 14.3 in (2024), 12.2 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between February 27 and April 19, carried from the melt-out date at Buckskin Lower (6,920 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Buckskin Lower
evidence.detail: melted out April 3, 552 ft above the pass; points to February 27 to April 19
